title: Mind MGMT: New & Improved #5
desc: ALL-NEW ARC! ALL-NEW JUMPING-ON POINT! From the mind of New York Times bestselling cartoonist and multiple Eisner Award nominee Matt Kindt (BRZRKR, Dept. H), enter a brand-new, self-contained starting point for the genre-bending, cerebellum-piercing "psy-fi" epic that AiPT! heralds as "an unsettling, must-read return that turns memory itself into the mystery."When Detectives Swon and Delphi are together, nothing can take them by surprise—or maybe that's what Mind Management wants them to believe. But their professional bond and uncanny abilities are about to be tested in more ways than one as Swon's feelings for his partner begin to deepen, and Deplhi experiences the full-on cognitive shellshock of another operative's tragic mission gone wrong. If only Swon's extrasensory cognition could let him see into the future . . . But, even if he did, it would already be too late. Welcome to the all-new Mind MGMT. We've been expecting you.
